<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3827">kha cig</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs> sogs rtogs sla nas ma bshad ces zer ba ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re rigs te 'di'i yongs sbyong sa dgu'i yon tan dang phrin las sbrel nas nyams su len pa yin la | de mtshan nyid bshad pas go sla ste <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> sa dgu'i yon tan <lb n="94b8"/> las lhag pa mngon du byas pas de las 'da' ba dang | sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang phrin las thob pas sangs rgyas kyi sar bshad pas rtogs so zhes gsung ngo  ||</seg></TEI>
